description: This file contains utility functions for handling file IDs, model extraction, MIME type detection, and request parameter parsing within the litellm project, specifically related to openai file endpoints.

classes.name: FileCreationParams
classes.description: Structured data class for parameters related to file creation requests, including target storage, model names, and model parameter.

methods.name: _is_base64_encoded_unified_file_id
methods.description: Checks if a given string is a base64-encoded unified file ID and if it starts with a specific prefix.

methods.name: convert_b64_uid_to_unified_uid
methods.description: Converts a base64 UID to a unified UID if it is encoded; otherwise returns the original UID.

methods.name: get_models_from_unified_file_id
methods.description: Extracts model names from a unified file ID string.

methods.name: get_model_id_from_unified_batch_id
methods.description: Extracts the model ID from a batch ID string.

methods.name: get_batch_id_from_unified_batch_id
methods.description: Extracts the batch ID from a unified batch ID string.

methods.name: encode_file_id_with_model
methods.description: Encodes a file or batch ID with embedded model routing information using base64.

methods.name: decode_model_from_file_id
methods.description: Decodes and extracts the model name from an encoded file or batch ID.

methods.name: get_original_file_id
methods.description: Retrieves the original provider file or batch ID from an encoded ID.

methods.name: is_model_embedded_id
methods.description: Checks if a file ID has embedded model routing information.

methods.name: extract_model_from_sources
methods.description: Extracts model info from embedded ID, request headers, query params, or request body.

methods.name: get_credentials_for_model
methods.description: Retrieves API credentials for a specified model from the router.

methods.name: prepare_data_with_credentials
methods.description: Updates a data dictionary with model credentials and optional file ID.

methods.name: handle_model_based_routing
methods.description: Coordinates model-based credential routing based on embedded ID, headers, query, or body.

methods.name: detect_content_type_from_filename
methods.description: Detects MIME type from filename extension, with custom mappings and fallback.

methods.name: normalize_mime_type_for_provider
methods.description: Normalizes MIME types for specific providers, e.g., Gemini, Vertex AI.

methods.name: is_gemini_supported_mime_type
methods.description: Checks if a MIME type is supported by Gemini multimodal models.

methods.name: get_content_type_from_file_object
methods.description: Determines MIME type from a file object, using filename or default.

methods.name: extract_file_creation_params
methods.description: Asynchronously extracts structured file creation parameters from a FastAPI request.

methods.name: _extract_target_storage_simple
methods.description: Extracts target storage parameter from form input, defaults to 'default'.

methods.name: _extract_target_model_names_simple
methods.description: Parses target model names from form input, returns list.

methods.name: _extract_model_param
methods.description: Extracts model parameter from request body, query, or headers.
